facts.function: engine part sensed for crankshaft position
facts.end_use: spark ignition internal combustion piston engines

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 8409 parts suitable for use solely or principally with engines of heading 8407; Section XVI note 2(b) sends a part not itself in another heading with its machine; chapter 90 and 85 not applicable as it is a passive blade
GRI 6: 8409.91 spark-ignition; 8409.91.50 other, to be installed in vehicles (assumed); 8409.91.50.85 other

rejected_alternatives.reason: other parts not for vehicles; applies if the engine is not to be installed in vehicles
not a crankshaft or transmission shaft
a passive blade is not itself ignition or starting equipment

missing_facts: Whether the engine is installed in vehicles of 8701-8704 (else 8409.91.99)
Material and whether the blade is part of an electrical sensor assembly
classification.rationale: A crankshaft sensing blade is a part dedicated to spark-ignition piston engines, so heading 8409 via Section XVI note 2(b). Ruling N347490 (connecting rod) used 8409.91.50.xx for vehicle engine parts; assuming vehicle use and no specific line, 8409.91.50.85 is the residual line.
